description: Cross-check TEP-HC CMB power spectra and acoustic scale against LCDM baseline

residuals_percent.note: Direct TT/TE/EE spectrum residual comparison not performed: TEP-HC output arrays have incompatible normalizations. Acoustic-scale ratio is the robust cross-check.

validation.note: C0 independently verifies consistency with TEP-HC spectral outputs (TT + acoustic scale) but does not replace the full TEP-HC perturbation derivation. TE/EE cross-checks are not available in the TEP-HC output file.
